elements.requirement: The provision applies where a child was adopted by one natural parent acting as the sole adoptive parent.
elements.quote: child adopted by one natural parent as sole adoptive parent

elements.requirement: The adopted child must subsequently become a legitimated person upon the marriage of, or the formation of a civil partnership by, the child's natural parents.
elements.quote: subsequently becomes a legitimated person on the marriage of, or formation of a civil partnership by, the natural parents

elements.requirement: An application to revoke the adoption order must be made by any of the parties concerned.
elements.quote: on the application of any of the parties concerned

elements.requirement: The court by which the adoption order was made has the power to revoke the adoption order.
elements.quote: the court by which the adoption order was made may, on the application of any of the parties concerned, revoke the order
